messages.subject: help with contrast.enhance in image() function
messages.subject_clean: help with contrast.enhance in image() function
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

I encountered a problem when plotting the MALDI image.

When I image my peak without using contrast.enhance = "histogram" in image() function, I am able to visualize the distribution.

But when I use the `contrast.enhance` parameter in image() function, I got the following error:

For contrast.enhance = "histogram" :

Error in image.default(1, vals, t(as.matrix(vals)), col = col, xaxt = "n",  :

  increasing 'x' and 'y' values expected

For contrast.enhance = "suppression" :

Error in seq.default(from = range[1], to = range[2], length.out = 100) :

  'from' must be a finite number

How to solve this problem? Thanks a lot.

Hu
